sources.title: NVIDIA DPU与主机接口角色
sources.actual_read: independent specialist actual HTML body lines 39–64, 148–166
sources.supports: One documented DPU implementation combines network interfaces, infrastructure processing/offload and host-side PCIe connectivity. NIC/network-facing and host-facing roles differ.
sources.does_not_support: Product example, not all NIC/DPU architectures. No rates, lane/core counts, power, firmware guarantees or supplier installation transplanted into generic asset.

sources.title: NVIDIA 光电与线缆配接定义
sources.actual_read: independent specialist actual HTML body lines 28–48, 135–165; owner additionally actual same official body read
sources.supports: Optical transceiver converts between electrical and optical domains; fiber/optical patching differs from direct electrical copper cable. Connector form factor and physical medium are separate concepts.
sources.does_not_support: Only basic roles adopted. Historical portfolio rate/reach/MSA/compatibility examples and broad marketing comparisons are not applied to source drawings. No source webpage images claimed viewed.

sources.title: Broadcom CPO集成示例
sources.actual_read: independent specialist actual PDF physical page 1, Overview lines 26–58; page 2 publication line 65; owner additionally actual same official body read
sources.supports: One CPO architecture integrates optical engines with network-switch silicon, rather than treating a separate pluggable transceiver as a co-packaged engine. Network switching/routing is a different functional role from host PCIe switching.
sources.does_not_support: Uses functional distinction only. Specific ASIC, front-panel fiber counts, process, bandwidth, power/reliability claims and topology are not generic picture facts.

sources.title: Broadcom PCIe交换功能示例
sources.actual_read: independent specialist actual PDF physical page 1 lines 24–39; page 2 lines 77–84,106–130; page 3 lines151–157; publication page4 line249; owner additionally actual same official body read
sources.supports: PCIe switch supports host/I/O connectivity and fan-out; selected simple example may be inside a server. The source also supports in-rack PCIe fabrics, so PCIe must not be defined as physically incapable of leaving a chassis.
sources.does_not_support: 2019 implementation example for stable function only, not current standard/version or candidate model certification. It does not certify CXL support of the generic pcie-switch picture, nor mandate a PCIe switch on every host/NIC path.

sources.title: TI Retimer功能解释
sources.actual_read: independent specialist actual Introduction / When Should a PCIe Retimer be Implemented, lines9–19; owner additionally actual same official body read
sources.supports: PCIe retimer recovers clock/data and regenerates an impaired high-speed signal. This conditioning role differs from fan-out switching or network-packet forwarding.
sources.does_not_support: No fixed loss threshold, protocol version, universal retimer requirement or chip placement adopted. This PCIe example does not certify every AEC/Ethernet retimer family.

sources.title: Credo AEC有源铜缆示例
sources.actual_read: independent specialist actual HTML body AEC Attributes lines645–668; category heading and copper media lines90–99
sources.supports: One AEC product family places active signal-processing circuitry in copper cable ends; a copper exterior alone cannot distinguish passive direct attach from a chosen active implementation.
sources.does_not_support: No numeric rates/reach/weight/power/reliability or universal active-cable circuit claim adopted. Existing copper illustration remains externally generic, not a certified Credo device or AEC.

scope: Stable functional relationships only; no OEM/installed topology or referencepixels certification
